name.value: Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Fort Saint John

description.value: The Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham is a modern budget-oriented hotel on the south side of Fort St. John, a major service hub along the Alaska Highway corridor. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, guests can earn and redeem loyalty points. Fort St. John is a practical overnight stop for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway, and this property sits within reach of the town's commercial amenities.
